items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Sonny Greer told me that the first time that was in New York he the first time that the guys heard a string bass was in Jean Gene Bollette's band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes.

ctx.x: Now, what -- did -- were there any particular people that you modeled yourself on in your early years of playing the bass? Because now -- because this is the reason I ask you. Sonny Greer told me that the first time that was in New York he the first time that the guys heard a string bass was in Jean Gene Bollette's band. Before that everybody played tuba.
